name: EDOCS
tagline: Sign, accept or reject legally binding e-documents from a phone
role: Mobile development for edocs.uz — 2020 app and 2025 rebuild

scenes.title: Every e-document in one inbox
scenes.body: Invoices, acts, waybills and powers of attorney, color-coded: signed, awaiting signature or rejected.

scenes.title: Swipe to sign, tap to view
scenes.body: Cards reveal sign, share and bookmark actions; the viewer shows the official layout with QR code and stamps.

scenes.title: 13 document types, one filter
scenes.body: Narrow by counterparty INN/PINFL, number or date — or scan a QR code to find a document or receipt.

scenes.title: One phone login, every company
scenes.body: One-time-code sign-in or a demo mode, then balance and monthly document stats for each legal entity.

scenes.title: Where it started: the 2020 app
scenes.body: Our first EDOCS app shipped in 2020 with inbox, outbox and invoice creation, before the 2025 rebuild.
